title: CapCover Filter: Semantic Approximate Membership Queries over Embeddings
abstract: arXiv:2611.20132v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Determining whether an embedding is sufficiently similar to any vector in a vector store without performing a nearest-neighbor search can substantially improve query throughput in vector-store systems. We study Semantic Approximate Membership Queries (SAMQs), which allow queries to be rejected when no indexed vector meets the requested similarity threshold, while guaranteeing no false negatives.   We introduce CapCover Filter, a geometric data structure that summarizes a set of embeddings using spherical caps. Its representation is independent of the query threshold, allowing a single filter to support arbitrary thresholds without reconstruction. We evaluate alternative construction and quantization methods, compare CapCover Filter with competing filters, and measure its impact on query throughput. translated_title: CapCover Filter：基于嵌入向量的语义近似成员查询
translated_abstract: 在不执行最近邻搜索的情况下判断一个嵌入向量是否与向量存储中的任何向量足够相似，可以显著提升向量存储系统的查询吞吐量。我们研究了语义近似成员查询（SAMQs），当没有索引向量满足所要求的相似度阈值时，该查询允许直接拒绝查询请求，同时保证不会产生假阴性。我们提出了 CapCover Filter，这是一种使用球冠来概括一组嵌入向量的几何数据结构。其表示形式与查询阈值无关，使得单个过滤器能够支持任意阈值而无需重建。我们评估了不同的构建和量化方法，将 CapCover Filter 与竞争过滤器进行了比较，并衡量了其对查询吞吐量的影响。在五个真实世界数据集上，当余弦相似度阈值为 0.95 时，CapCover Filter 消除了大约 20--100% 的索引访问。
tldr: CapCover Filter 是一种基于球冠的几何数据结构，其表示与阈值无关，无需重建即可支持任意相似度阈值的语义近似成员查询，通过过滤不相似的查询请求显著提升向量存储系统的查询吞吐量。
en_tdlr: CapCover Filter is a threshold-independent geometric data structure based on spherical caps that enables Semantic Approximate Membership Queries supporting arbitrary similarity thresholds without reconstruction, substantially improving query throughput in vector-store systems by filtering out dissimilar queries.
